context: Run TPC-DS query 35 alone against ClickHouse Local at SF1 and capture the engine error. Decide whether it needs a sql_compat rewrite rule, a dialect translation fix, or is an upstream chDB limitation to document. If it is genuinely unsupported, record it as a known incompatibility rather than leaving the platform silently absent from the TPC-DS cohort.
description:
Found 2026-08-17 while assembling a TPC-DS cohort. Bundle tpcds_sf1_clickhouse_local_sql_20260813_184214_7bbbfc5c reports summary.queries = {passed: 306, failed: 3, total: 309} and summary.validation = 'partial'. All three failures are the same query - id 35 - failing on each of its 3 iterations; every other TPC-DS query passes. scripts/validate_submission.py correctly refuses the bundle ('summary.validation must be passed for public submissions, got partial'), so ClickHouse Local cannot join the published TPC-DS cohort until query 35 works. This is a genuine SQL-compatibility gap, not a validation artifact, and it is distinct from the two existing ClickHouse items: uat-clickhouse-server-query-compatibility concerns ClickHouse SERVER error routing, and uat-clickhouse-tpcds-sf001-runtime-performance concerns a runtime cap at SF0.01. Neither covers a query failure on ClickHouse LOCAL at SF1.

RECONCILED 2026-08-23: PR #1840 merged into develop at 4dd4673af5. The documented ClickHouse Local limitation path is now integrated: Q35 translation succeeds, but chDB still fails at the 8 GiB local envelope. Work unit w3 (clean SF1 cohort validation) remains unverified; preserve open deferral #719 and do not mark this TODO complete.

REVALIDATED 2026-09-04. Do not steal the live claim held by joe@joe-mac-mini.local. Public bundle results-data/bundles/tpcds_sf1_clickhouse_local_sql_20260826_112830_c250741b.json has summary.validation=passed, queries passed 309/309, and query 35 SUCCESS on warmup plus three measurement iterations (52.0/52.7/43.8/48.0 ms). ClickHouseAdapter.KNOWN_INCOMPATIBLE_QUERIES['tpcds'] is [14, 30, 81] and tests/unit/platforms/test_clickhouse_adapter.py asserts 35 is not listed. Live corpus tpcds SF1 includes ClickHouse Local (7 identities). The 2026-08-23 blocked reason is stale relative to this bundle. Claim holder should progress or finish w3 against this evidence; this topic will not take the claim.

deferrals.reason: The required full-cohort verification reproduced 306/309 passed with TPC-DS Q35 failing at chDBs 8 GiB MEMORY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED ceiling. PR #1840 documents and pins the limitation; w3 remains unresolved until Q35 is optimized, the local memory envelope is raised, or the upstream engine behavior changes.
